entities.summary: The Traunseebahn is an electrified metre-gauge railway running from Vorchdorf to Gmunden in Upper Austria, Austria. The line is 17.9 km (11.1 mi) long and is owned and operated by Stern & Hafferl. The railway opened on 21 March 1912 and since 2018 it has been connected to the Gmunden Tramway as part of the Traunseetram tram-train service.
